The /agents/deployments/conversation/read API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

AgentConversationResponse Model - Response wrapping the conversation transcript of an agent deployment.
success boolean
Indicate if the API request was successful.
errors string Array
List of errors with the API call.
conversation AgentConversation object
Full conversation transcript and metadata for an agent deployment.
Example 
{
  "success": true,
  "errors": [
    "string"
  ],
  "conversation": {
    "id": "string",
    "userId": 0,
    "organizationId": "string",
    "channel": "string",
    "projectId": 0,
    "prompt": "string",
    "agents": [
      {}
    ],
    "notificationTargets": [
      {}
    ],
    "messages": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "role": "user",
        "parts": [
          {
            "type": "text",
            "text": "string",
            "state": "string",
            "toolName": "string",
            "input": {},
            "output": {},
            "messages": [
              {}
            ]
          }
        ],
        "time": "string"
      }
    ],
    "agentProperties": {},
    "chatMessages": [
      {}
    ],
    "inputTokens": 0,
    "outputTokens": 0,
    "aggregateStatus": "Running"
  }
}
AgentConversation Model - Full conversation transcript and metadata for an agent deployment.
id string
Identifier of the deployment this conversation belongs to.
userId integer
Identifier of the user that owns the deployment.
organizationId string
Identifier of the organization that owns the deployment.
channel string
Internal pub/sub channel of the deployment.
projectId integer
Identifier of the project the deployment runs against.
prompt string
Prompt the deployment is executing.
agents object Array
Agent definitions participating in the conversation.
notificationTargets object Array
Notification targets configured for the deployment.
messages AgentConversationMessage Array
Conversation messages, in order.
agentProperties object
Per-agent runtime properties.
chatMessages object Array
Flat chat-style transcript of the conversation.
inputTokens integer
Total input tokens consumed by the deployment so far.
outputTokens integer
Total output tokens produced by the deployment so far.
aggregateStatus string
example: Running
Aggregate status of the deployment.
Example 
{
  "id": "string",
  "userId": 0,
  "organizationId": "string",
  "channel": "string",
  "projectId": 0,
  "prompt": "string",
  "agents": [
    {}
  ],
  "notificationTargets": [
    {}
  ],
  "messages": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "role": "user",
      "parts": [
        {
          "type": "text",
          "text": "string",
          "state": "string",
          "toolName": "string",
          "input": {},
          "output": {},
          "messages": [
            {}
          ]
        }
      ],
      "time": "string"
    }
  ],
  "agentProperties": {},
  "chatMessages": [
    {}
  ],
  "inputTokens": 0,
  "outputTokens": 0,
  "aggregateStatus": "Running"
}
AgentConversationMessage Model - One message in an agent conversation.
id string
Identifier of the message.
role string
example: user
Author of the message.
parts AgentConversationMessagePart Array
Ordered parts that make up the message.
time string
Timestamp the message was produced.
Example 
{
  "id": "string",
  "role": "user",
  "parts": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "text": "string",
      "state": "string",
      "toolName": "string",
      "input": {},
      "output": {},
      "messages": [
        {}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "time": "string"
}
AgentConversationMessagePart Model - One part of a conversation message.
type string
example: text
Kind of part (text, reasoning, dynamic-tool, step-start, etc.).
text string
Text content, when the part is text or reasoning.
state string
State of a tool-call part, when applicable.
toolName string
Name of the invoked tool, for dynamic-tool parts.
input object
Input passed to the tool, for dynamic-tool parts.
output object
Output returned by the tool, for dynamic-tool parts.
messages object Array
Sub-messages produced by the part, when applicable.
Example 
{
  "type": "text",
  "text": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "toolName": "string",
  "input": {},
  "output": {},
  "messages": [
    {}
  ]
}

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
